correct.description: Body forms a straight line from heels to head, elbows track back at 45 degrees, chest reaches near floor

common_errors.description: Elbows flare out beyond 60 degrees from torso
Hips drop below straight-line body position
Elbows do not reach 90 degrees — insufficient depth

coaching_cues.setup: Hands shoulder-width apart, body in a straight line from heels to head
coaching_cues.execution: Keep your elbows at 45 degrees, lower until chest nearly touches the floor
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Strong set. Next one, focus on {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.elbow_flare: Tuck your elbows in closer to your body
flag_cues.hip_sag: Engage your core — keep your hips level
flag_cues.shallow_pushup: Go a little lower — elbows to 90 degrees

shoulder_injury.modification: Narrow your hand position and reduce depth. Try knee push-ups or an incline against a wall. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

back_injury.modification: Brace your core hard to prevent hip sag, which loads the lower back. Try knee push-ups to reduce spinal demand.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you press up.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. uneven press, head drop, scapular winging). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.

camera_guidance.framing_note: Phone on the floor ~1.5m away, side profile. Whole body from head to feet must be visible.
